decisive_items: RT-PCR tests from nasopharyngeal swabs: positive (Feb 8)
rhinorrhea and nasal congestion, without cough, vomiting, diarrhea, wheezing, or dyspnea
response.rationale: Positive RT-PCR from nasopharyngeal swab is the definitive diagnostic evidence; clinical presentation of mild upper respiratory symptoms and low-grade fever in an infant is consistent with COVID-19. Other viral candidates are contradicted by negative influenza/respiratory panel or lack of specific support.

rejected.why: Respiratory panel negative, no specific RSV evidence
Too broad, less specific than COVID-19
Influenza-like illness contradicted by negative influenza panel
No wheezing or respiratory distress to support bronchiolitis
Mediastinal enlargement is mild and not diagnostic of lymphadenitis
